The condition 'only task evidence is available' is the agent's own judgment and can't be observed in the run.
Depends on artifacts being unreadable or lacking usable requirements, scenarios or design decisions. That is a judgment that can't be observed, and the 'specific reason' text has no fixed form.

Depends on the CLI status fields taskTrackingConfigured and tasks, and on the apply state/instruction text. None of these can be observed.

SHOULD-level recommendation wording that applies only when tasks remain open at report time. That condition can't be expressed as an applies_when predicate, and the verify report has no template section/label to hold the phrase.
Depends on the status marking specs as skipped (skip_specs) or on the schema defining no spec artifact. Neither can be observed.
Applies when spec files are absent or empty. 'Empty' can't be expressed, and the verify report has no template labels for the per-check status values.
